scene: The kite flyer points out a tangled ribbon trailing behind her dragon.
picture: A flat side view of the grassy ridge. On the far left sits a mounted brass telescope. The boy in an orange puffer vest and kite stands left. In the centre, the girl holds a spool connected to a tangled gold ribbon on her line. Far right stands a cozy wooden tea hut with open door.
shown: a tangled shimmering gold ribbon caught on the girl's kite string in the centre
a mounted brass hilltop telescope pointed down towards the city on the far left
a rustic wooden tea hut with steam curling from its open door on the far right
